description: Phase 2 & 3: Multi-Tenancy and Sync - Database schema with bookie_id, Row Level Security policies, sync service, realtime subscriptions, offline mode. IMPORTANT: Maintain the existing dark sports-betting theme styling (Theme.swift).

userStories.title: Create Supabase Database Schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the database schema in Supabase to store all app data with multi-tenant support.
acceptanceCriteria: Create SQL migration file at supabase/migrations/001_initial_schema.sql
Create bookies table: id (uuid pk), auth_user_id (uuid references auth.users), name (text), created_at (timestamptz)
Create players table: id (uuid pk), bookie_id (uuid fk), auth_user_id (uuid nullable), name (text), status (text), collection_status (text nullable), created_at, updated_at
Create events table: id (uuid pk), bookie_id (uuid fk), name (text), sport (text), start_time (timestamptz), status (text), home_team (text), away_team (text), created_at, updated_at

Create bets table: id (uuid pk), bookie_id (uuid fk), player_id (uuid fk), event_id (text), ticket_id (uuid), stake (decimal), odds (int), side (text), status (text), grade_result (text nullable), is_parlay (bool), parlay_legs (int), created_at, updated_at
Create ledger_entries table: id (uuid pk), bookie_id (uuid fk), player_id (uuid fk), bet_id (uuid nullable fk), amount (decimal), type (text), description (text), created_at
Create acceptance_policies table: id (uuid pk), bookie_id (uuid fk unique), max_stake (decimal), require_approval_above (decimal nullable), auto_accept_enabled (bool), created_at, updated_at
All tables have bookie_id for tenant isolation
Add indexes on bookie_id for all tables
Document schema in supabase/README.md
Project builds and runs in Simulator
userStories.notes: Foundation schema - run this migration in Supabase SQL editor

userStories.title: Implement Row Level Security Policies
userStories.description: As a developer, I need RLS policies so bookies only see their own data.
acceptanceCriteria: Create SQL migration file at supabase/migrations/002_rls_policies.sql
Enable RLS on all tables: ALTER TABLE tablename ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
Create helper function get_user_bookie_id() that returns bookie_id for current auth.uid()
Bookies policy: SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE where bookie_id = get_user_bookie_id()
Players policy: bookie can CRUD all players, player can SELECT own record only
Events policy: bookie can CRUD, players can SELECT events from their bookie
Bets policy: bookie can CRUD all bets, player can SELECT/INSERT own bets only
Ledger policy: bookie can CRUD, player can SELECT own entries
Acceptance policies: bookie only, full CRUD on own record
Document policies in supabase/README.md
Project builds and runs in Simulator
userStories.notes: RLS enforces data isolation at database level - even if client code has bugs, data is protected

userStories.title: Add Sync Fields to SwiftData Models
userStories.description: As a developer, I need sync-related fields on local models to track sync state.
acceptanceCriteria: Add to all syncable models (Player, Event, Bet, LedgerEntry, AcceptancePolicy): bookieId (UUID?), needsSync (Bool default true), lastSyncedAt (Date?), version (Int default 1)
Add syncable models: SettlementPeriod, PlayerSettlement with same sync fields
Create protocol Syncable with these properties for type consistency
Update model initializers to set bookieId from AuthManager.currentBookieId
Existing local data will have nil bookieId until first sync
Project builds and runs in Simulator
userStories.notes: Prepares local models for bidirectional sync

userStories.title: Create Bookie Record on Signup
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a bookie record created in Supabase when a new bookie signs up.
acceptanceCriteria: After successful auth.signUp or Apple Sign-In, insert row into bookies table
Set auth_user_id to the new user's ID
Set name from email prefix or Apple provided name
Store bookie.id in AuthManager as currentBookieId
On login, fetch bookie record and set currentBookieId
If bookie record doesn't exist on login (edge case), create it
Handle errors gracefully with user feedback
Project builds and runs in Simulator
userStories.notes: Links auth user to bookie record for RLS policies to work

userStories.title: Create Sync Service Infrastructure
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a sync service to coordinate data between SwiftData and Supabase.
acceptanceCriteria: Create SyncService.swift in Booki/Services/ as ObservableObject
Add SyncStatus enum: idle, syncing, error(String), offline
Add published properties: syncStatus, lastSyncedAt (Date?), pendingChangesCount (Int)
Add method sync() that coordinates full sync cycle
Add method syncTable(_ table: SyncableTable) for targeted sync
Create SyncableTable enum listing all syncable tables
Inject SyncService via environment in BookiApp.swift
Show sync status indicator in main UI (e.g., toolbar)
Project builds and runs in Simulator
userStories.notes: Central coordinator for all sync operations

userStories.title: Implement Download Sync
userStories.description: As a bookie, I want server data to sync to my device so I see the latest state.
acceptanceCriteria: Create downloadAll() method in SyncService
On app launch (if authenticated), trigger download sync
Fetch from Supabase: players, events, bets, ledger_entries, acceptance_policies
For each record: if exists locally, update if server.updated_at > local.updated_at
For each record: if not exists locally, insert into SwiftData
Set needsSync = false and lastSyncedAt = now for downloaded records
Handle pagination for tables with many records (limit 1000)
Show progress during sync
Project builds and runs in Simulator
userStories.notes: Server is source of truth for download sync

userStories.title: Implement Upload Sync
userStories.description: As a bookie, I want local changes to upload to the server so other devices see them.
acceptanceCriteria: Create uploadPendingChanges() method in SyncService
Find all records where needsSync = true
For each pending record: upsert to Supabase (insert or update based on id)
Include version number in upsert for conflict detection
On success: set needsSync = false, increment version, update lastSyncedAt
On failure: keep needsSync = true, log error, continue with other records
Trigger upload after any local write (create/update/delete)
Batch uploads when possible for efficiency
Project builds and runs in Simulator
userStories.notes: Local changes push to server when online

userStories.title: Implement Realtime Subscriptions
userStories.description: As a bookie, I want changes from other devices to appear automatically.
acceptanceCriteria: Create RealtimeService.swift in Booki/Services/
On login: subscribe to Supabase Realtime channels for all tenant tables
Filter subscriptions by bookie_id using RLS (automatic)
Listen for INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE events
On INSERT/UPDATE: upsert into local SwiftData
On DELETE: remove from local SwiftData
On logout: unsubscribe from all channels
Handle reconnection after network loss
Project builds and runs in Simulator

userStories.title: Implement Conflict Resolution
userStories.description: As a bookie, I want to be notified if my change conflicts with another device.
acceptanceCriteria: Before upload: check if server version > local version
If conflict detected: abort upload for that record
Fetch latest server version and update local copy
Show alert: 'This record was modified elsewhere. Your changes were not saved.'
Provide 'View Current' button to see the server version
Log conflicts for debugging (record id, local version, server version)
First-write-wins: the first successful write is kept
Project builds and runs in Simulator
userStories.notes: Prevents silent data loss from concurrent edits

userStories.title: Add Network Monitor and Offline Mode
userStories.description: As a bookie, I want to know when I'm offline and understand limitations.
acceptanceCriteria: Create NetworkMonitor.swift using NWPathMonitor
Publish isConnected: Bool property
Add as environment object in BookiApp.swift
When offline: show banner 'You are offline' at top of main views
When offline: disable write operations with message 'Requires internet connection'
Allow viewing/reading all local data while offline
When connection restored: hide banner, trigger sync
Debounce connection changes to avoid flicker
Project builds and runs in Simulator
userStories.notes: User always knows connectivity state and what they can do
